title: AI / Agentic Automation Engineer : Remote
description:
**AI / Agentic Automation Engineer**  
**Experience:** 2–6 Years  
**Job Location:** Remote / Work From Home (Candidates must be based in Mumbai, Hyderabad, or Bengaluru)  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Working Days:** 5 Days a Week  
**Working Hours:** 9 Hours per Day

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced **AI / Agentic Automation Engineer** to develop and implement AI-powered applications, intelligent automation workflows, and LLM-based solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with agentic workflows, workflow automation platforms, API integrations, and AI-driven business process automation.

The candidate will work on integrating AI models with business applications, e-commerce platforms, marketplaces, and messaging systems to build scalable and efficient automation solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and implement AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Build and manage agentic workflows and intelligent automation solutions.
* Develop workflow automations using n8n or similar automation platforms.
* Integrate LLMs with business applications, third-party APIs, and external platforms.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and knowledge-base systems.
* Work with vector databases for efficient information retrieval and AI-powered search.
* Develop API integrations, webhooks, and third-party application connections.
* Build and maintain WhatsApp integrations and conversational commerce solutions.
* Develop automation scripts and backend services using Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Deploy and maintain AI applications using cloud-based infrastructure and API-driven architectures.
* Troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain automation workflows for reliability and scalability.

Required Skills

* Hands-on experience in LLM and AI application development.
* Strong understanding of agentic AI workflows and automation.
* Experience with n8n or comparable workflow automation tools.
* Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
* Knowledge of RAG, knowledge-base systems, and vector databases.
* Understanding of cloud deployment and API-based architectures.
* Experience integrating AI solutions with business applications and messaging platforms.

Preferred Experience

* Integration of LLMs with e-commerce platforms and online marketplaces.
* WhatsApp Business API or conversational commerce integrations.
* Development of AI agents for business process automation.
* Experience connecting multiple applications and services into end-to-end workflows.

Candidate Requirements

* 2–6 years of relevant experience in AI development, automation engineering, or related fields.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to develop scalable, reliable, and maintainable automation solutions.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

Work Arrangement

* **Work Mode:** 100% Remote / Work From Home
* **Eligible Locations:** Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Bengaluru only
* **Working Schedule:** 5 days a week
* **Compensation:** Based on current/last-drawn salary and experience

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

We are seeking a **Connectivity Automation Developer** to design, implement, and optimize automated network solutions across our enterprise environments. * Design, implement, and optimize automated network solutions across enterprise environments
* Integrate network platforms and services with automation frameworks
* Develop automation workflows for network operations
* Ensure scalable, secure, and reliable connectivity
* Collaborate with global teams on automation initiatives
* Gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Deliver automation that improves efficiency, standardization, and service quality
* Implement solutions using Cisco networking technologies
* Troubleshoot and solve complex network automation problems

### **Your Profile**

We are looking for a **Connectivity Automation Developer** with extensive network engineering experience, strong Cisco technology knowledge, and automation expertise to design and implement automated network solutions.

#### **Must Have Skills**

* 5 years of experience in network engineering with 2 years in automation
* Strong knowledge of Cisco networking technologies (routing, switching, VLANs, BGP, OSPF)
* Experience with GitHub
* Experience with YANG, RESTCONF, NETCONF
* Experience with data encoding formats (XML, JSON)
* Proficiency in automation tools (Ansible, Python)
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Strong collaboration and communication skills in an international environment
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)

#### **Nice to Have Skills**

* Experience with Azure and AWS
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with ITSM processes (change, incident, problem management)
* Cisco CCNP or DevNet certifications

### **About Us**

**T-Systems Information and Communication Technology India Private Limited (T-Systems ICT India Pvt. Ltd.)** is a certified Great Place To Work®, proudly recognized for its strong people-first culture and commitment to employee excellence.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of T-Systems International GmbH, T-Systems India operates out of Pune and Bangalore, with a dynamic team of over 4,200 professionals delivering high-value IT services to group customers worldwide.

T-Systems India plays a key role in this global vision by delivering integrated, end-to-end IT solutions and sector-specific software to drive transformation across industries, including:

* Automotive
* Manufacturing
* Logistics
* Transportation
* Healthcare
* Public sector

For over 25 years, **T-Systems International GmbH** has been at the forefront of digital innovation, driving progress and fostering digital optimism. As a leading European IT services provider and a proud part of Deutsche Telekom, T-Systems delivers transformative digitalization projects backed by deep expertise in:

* Consulting
* Cloud
* AI
* Cybersecurity
* Connectivity

With a global workforce of 26,000 employees across 26 countries, we set industry benchmarks in efficiency, sovereignty, security, and reliability—empowering organizations to unlock their full digital potential.

With annual revenues exceeding EUR 4.0 billion (2024), **T-Systems stands as one of Europe's foremost digital transformation partners**, committed to shaping the future of enterprise technology.

title: QA Automation Lead
description:
Posted on: 13-10-2026

Experience: 8-12 years

India-Bengaluru

Job ID #1002286

  

### **Role Requirements**

* Skills: SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, Complex Views, CTEs, Window Functions, Indexing, Query Plans, Azure Data Factory, SSIS, ETL/ELT, Python, PowerShell, Data Modeling, Data Reconciliation, Data Validation, JSON, Git, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, dbt, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric
* Own the end-to-end migration strategy, including extraction, mapping, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and cutover.
* Profile and reverse-engineer legacy SQL Server databases, views, and materialized view outputs with little or no documentation.

* Design and build repeatable, idempotent ETL/ELT pipelines for a 10-year historical data load.
* Define data quality rules, cleansing logic, and exception handling for bad, duplicate, and orphaned records.
* Build automated reconciliation using row counts, checksums, aggregates, and record-level comparisons between legacy and target systems.
* Run parallel legacy-versus-platform cycles, including comparison of JSON report outputs, and drive defects to closure.
* Plan and rehearse production cutover, including runbooks, mock migrations, timing, rollback, and sign-off criteria.
* Work with the Solution Architect, Business Analysts, and client SMEs to resolve data rules and business definitions.
* Lead and review the work of a Data Migration Engineer and set coding and testing standards.
* Tune load performance and query performance on large historical datasets.
* Report migration status, risks, and data issues clearly and early to client stakeholders.
* Have 8–12 years of data engineering experience, including at least 2 large legacy-to-cloud migrations delivered end to end as the lead.
* Demonstrate expert T-SQL skills, including complex views, stored procedures, CTEs, window functions, indexing, and query plans.
* Have deep SQL Server experience and hands-on Azure SQL Database experience, including serverless or elastic tiers.
* Have strong ETL/ELT tooling experience with Azure Data Factory and/or SSIS, plus scripting in Python or PowerShell.
* Demonstrate proven data reconciliation and validation practices using automated checks rather than manual spot-checking.
* Have data modeling experience for transactional (OLTP) and reporting workloads.
* Be comfortable reading and producing JSON and comparing structured outputs between systems.
* Have cutover planning experience, including mock runs, rollback plans, and go/no-go criteria.
* Have experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps for database code and migration jobs.
* Have led or mentored at least 1–2 engineers.
* Demonstrate clear written and spoken English and the ability to work directly with US client stakeholders.
* Survey, assessment, or research data experience, including Qualtrics exports, respondent-level data, and longitudinal datasets, is good to have.
* Education-sector data experience, such as school or district reference data, is preferred.
* Experience with event-driven or microservices architectures and data flows through queues is preferred.
* Experience with Azure Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, dbt, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep is good to have.
* Experience with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot is good to have.
* Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) certification or equivalent is preferred.

-------------------

Requisition ID: 1735916

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title:** EY GDS – AI Automation Engineer, Technology Consulting

At EY, we’re all in shape to your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**About the Role:**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is seeking a high-performing AI Automation Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-driven automation solutions for enterprise and client environments. This role focuses on hands-on engineering, building scalable AI-powered workflows, and accelerating delivery through intelligent automation and generative AI capabilities.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to implement production-grade AI use cases across application security, offensive security, and enterprise workflows using modern AI tooling, LLM frameworks, and automation platforms.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with working knowledge of generative AI, automation frameworks, and secure development practices, and demonstrates the ability to translate business needs into scalable AI-enabled solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, test, and deploy AI-driven automation workflows using LLMs, agent frameworks, and orchestration tools.
* Build and integrate AI-powered solutions into enterprise pipelines, including CI/CD workflows and cloud environments.
* Implement automation for use cases such as code generation, testing, vulnerability analysis, documentation, and knowledge retrieval.
* Work with generative AI tools including OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, and similar platforms to accelerate engineering productivity.
* Develop and support Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, prompt engineering strategies, and evaluation datasets.
* Contribute to AI harness frameworks, evaluation pipelines, benchmarking models, and fine-tuning datasets.
* Implement agentic workflows using modern frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent.
* Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to translate solution designs into working implementations.
* Ensure adherence to secure coding standards and integrate DevSecOps practices in AI solution delivery.
* Work closely with client stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver measurable automation outcomes.

  

**Cyber Experience (Any One Preferred):**

**Application Security:**

* Secure coding practices, static and dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST), DevSecOps, CI/CD integration
* API security, OWASP Top 10, software supply chain security, secrets management

  

**Offensive Security:**

* Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), red teaming, adversarial testing
* Exposure to AI/LLM security risks including prompt injection, jailbreaks, and model misuse

  

**Technical Skills and Expertise:**

* Programming: Python (mandatory), with exposure to JavaScript or other scripting languages
* AI/LLM Tools: OpenAI Codex, Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, or similar tools
* AI Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalents
* Cloud Platforms: Azure (preferred), AWS, or GCP
* AI Platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, Vertex AI, or similar
* Prototyping Tools: Replit, notebooks, rapid experimentation tools
* Data & Pipelines: Basic understanding of data ingestion, preprocessing, vector databases, embeddings
* Concepts: RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, fine-tuning basics, evaluation methods, agentic workflows

  

**Soft Skills and Attributes:**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Effective communication and collaboration with global teams
* Ability to work in fast-paced consulting environments
* Continuous learning mindset with interest in emerging AI trends

  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, or related field
* 2–4 years of experience in software engineering, automation, or AI-driven solution delivery
* Hands-on experience with generative AI tools and automation frameworks
* Relevant certifications are a plus:
* Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate
* AWS Machine Learning Specialty
* Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)

  

**What we offer you**

**Job Description Summary**
===========================


We are seeking an experienced Staff Automation Engineer to lead automation strategy, framework development, and quality engineering practices for cloud\-native healthcare applications and enterprise data platforms within AIS Digital – Imaging360\. The ideal candidate will bring 8–10 years of experience across UI, API, ETL, database, cloud, and data validation automation, with strong expertise in Playwright, TypeScript, PyTest, REST API automation, AWS, SQL, and CI/CD integration.  

  

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.**Job Description**
===================


Roles and Responsibilities:


In this role, you will:

* Lead automation strategy, framework architecture, and roadmap execution across applications, services, and data platforms.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, deployment validation, and end\-to\-end testing using Playwright, TypeScript, PyTest, Python, SQL, and REST API tools.
* Define and execute validation strategies for ETL pipelines, data warehouses, data migration, source\-to\-target reconciliation, data quality, business rules, and analytical reporting outputs.
* Validate cloud\-native microservices and enterprise data services deployed on AWS, including RDS platforms such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
* Integrate automation into Agile and DevOps workflows, including CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, release\-readiness checks, and shift\-left testing practices.
* Drive Scrum\-level test governance by defining standards, tracking test and automation coverage, reviewing adherence to best practices, and improving sprint\-level quality discipline.
* Promote AI\-enabled testing across strategy, test design, test data preparation, automation development, execution analysis, defect triage, and reporting.
* Guide, mentor, and review automation engineers’ test strategy, framework design, code quality, reusable components, pull requests, and implementation approach.
* Showcase automation effectiveness, test coverage, quality risks, defect trends, and release readiness through dashboards, metrics, traceability reports, and stakeholder summaries.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, product owners, DevOps, system test, and integration test teams to solve technical problems and continuously improve quality outcomes.

**Technical Skill Set:**

* **Automation frameworks:** Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright, TypeScript, PyTest, Python, REST API automation, reusable automation patterns, reporting, and data\-driven execution.
* **Quality engineering:** Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, TDD/BDD, shift\-left testing, test pyramid, risk\-based testing, test coverage, traceability, and quality gates.
* **Data and database testing:** Expertise in ETL testing, data warehouse validation, data migration, SQL validation, source\-to\-target reconciliation, data quality checks, query optimization, and business rule validation.
* + **Cloud and DevOps:** Experience testing AWS\-based microservices, cloud data services, RDS platforms, Git/GitLab, Jenkins, Artifactory, CI/CD pipelines, deployment validation, and release automation.
* **AI\-enabled testing:** Hands\-on use of GenAI tools such as GitHub Copilot for test strategy, test data preparation, test design, automation scripting, execution analysis, defect triage, and quality reporting.
* **Governance and reporting:** Ability to define and present test coverage, automation coverage, quality metrics, risk coverage, Scrum\-level governance, and best\-practice adoption across Agile teams.
* **Technical leadership:** Ability to guide, mentor, and review automation engineers’ design, code, and strategy while influencing quality practices and communicating automation status, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders.

**Education Qualification:**

* Bachelor’ s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related STEM discipline with 8–10 years of relevant experience in software testing, test automation, quality engineering, cloud testing, or enterprise data platform validation.

**Desired Characteristics:**

* Experience leading automation initiatives for healthcare applications, regulated software products, SaaS solutions, or enterprise data platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to define automation strategy, institutionalize testing best practices, and scale quality engineering practices across Scrum teams.
* Strong technical problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex automation, test data, environment, cloud, and data validation challenges.
* Experience collaborating with architects, developers, product owners, DevOps engineers, system test teams, integration test teams, and quality stakeholders.
* + Ability to build dashboards, reports, and metrics that clearly communicate test coverage, automation progress, risks, dependencies, and release readiness.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to mentor engineers, influence decisions, and drive continuous improvement.
